claims.claim: Finland's LVV ordered Tuike Finland to suspend preparatory work at Muhos and Kajaani data-centre sites by 23 October 2026 until environmental impact assessments are completed.
claims.episode_span: suspend by 23 October 2026 all preparatory work that would significantly alter the environment at planned data-centre sites in Muhos and Kajaani
claims.supporting_quote: 23 October 2026, all preparatory measures that would significantly alter the environment in connection with the planned data centre projects in Muhos and Kajaani

claims.claim: Google announced in September a 13 billion euro investment in digital infrastructure in Finland over two years and called the projects its single biggest investment in Europe.
claims.episode_span: Google said in September it would invest 13 billion euros, about 14.6 billion dollars
claims.source_title: Finland orders halt to work on Google data centre sites
claims.supporting_quote: The United States tech giant announced in September a 13 billion euro ($14.6bn) investment in digital infrastructure in Finland over the next two years to power its artificial intelligence (AI) ambitions.

claims.claim: Tommi Muilu said trees were removed, topsoil stripped, site roads and storage areas constructed and ditches altered at the Finnish sites.
claims.episode_span: Tommi Muilu said trees have been removed, topsoil stripped, site roads and storage areas built, and ditches altered
claims.source_title: Finland orders halt to work on Google data centre sites
claims.supporting_quote: The head of LVV’s environment department, Tommi Muilu, said trees have been removed, topsoil stripped, site roads and storage areas constructed and ditches altered.

claims.claim: Hanna Halmeenpaa told AFP that nature sites which should be preserved had been logged across more than 300 hectares.
claims.episode_span: nature sites which should be preserved had been logged across a deforested area of more than 300 hectares
claims.source_title: Finland orders halt to work on Google data centre sites
claims.supporting_quote: Hanna Halmeenpaa, chair of the Finnish Association for Nature Conservation, told the AFP news agency that “nature sites which should be preserved” had been logged in a deforested area of more than 300 hectares (741 acres).

claims.claim: Tuike Finland must provide an explanation by October 14 and could face enforcement proceedings if it fails to comply.
claims.episode_span: Tuike Finland must explain how it intends to proceed by 14 October
claims.source_title: Finland orders halt to work on Google data centre sites
claims.supporting_quote: Tuike Finland must provide an explanation and detail how it intends to proceed by October 14.

claims.claim: Google spokesman Sondre Ronander acknowledged shortcomings, said the company would follow LVV guidance, and said plans include tree planting across 130 hectares at Muhos.
claims.episode_span: Sondre Ronander told AFP the company acknowledged shortcomings, would study the findings and follow the guidance
claims.source_title: Finland orders halt to work on Google data centre sites
claims.supporting_quote: Google spokesman Sondre Ronander acknowledged in a statement to AFP the company’s shortcomings and said it would “study the LVV’s findings and follow their guidance”.

claims.claim: Norway's minority Labour government proposed withdrawing 608.4 billion Norwegian crowns, about 63.61 billion dollars, from the wealth fund in 2027, up from a revised 583.4 billion in 2026.

claims.claim: Norway expects mainland GDP growth of 1.1 percent this year versus 1.7 percent seen in May, and 1.7 percent in 2027 versus 1.6 percent previously, with the 2027 structural non-oil deficit at 2.7 percent of the fund.
